content.text: [Email dr.kim@artemisq → fca-reporting Mon Nov 04 09:00 EST 2024] Subject: MiFIR Transaction Report Correction — Field 28 Timestamps. Dear FCA, following the 2024-11-03 DST transition, our AROS v4.2 system submitted transaction reports with Field 28 timestamps using UTC-4 offset instead of UTC-5 (EST). We are initiating corrected submissions. Please advise on your preferred correction protocol.

Logged FCA notification: Field 28 error — UTC-4 instead of UTC-5 used for timestamps on 2024-11-03 transaction reports. Corrected resubmission required per FCA Market Watch 59. Awaiting FCA response on correction protocol.

[Email fca-reporting → dr.kim@artemisq Tue Nov 05 11:00 EST 2024] Subject: RE: MiFIR Transaction Report Correction — Field 28 Timestamps. Per FCA Market Watch 59, Field 28 must be reported in UTC. The DST transition error you describe (UTC-4 vs UTC-5) is precisely the pattern we documented. Please submit corrected reports and a formal explanation referencing Market Watch 59 within 10 business days. Include reference to the specific DST transition date (2024-11-03).

FCA confirmed: Field 28 must be UTC per Market Watch 59. They require corrected reports plus a formal explanation within 10 business days. The explanation must reference Market Watch 59 and cite the specific DST transition (2024-11-03). I will draft the correction report for output/mifir_field28_correction.md.
